record.question: Hospital administrator has to perform leadership role in
options: Implement divisions of the governing board
To keep up the quality of care provided to patients at all level
To face medico-legal and ethical issues related to the hospital
record.explanation: Answer D: All of the above. Hospital administrators implement governing-board direction, oversee quality of care, and address medico-legal and ethical concerns; all are leadership responsibilities. Reference: https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789240015731. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
